title: Mercedes Moné Drops Sasha Banks Reference at AEW Grand Slam
text:
MEXICO, 2025-06-19 02:22:00
Mercedes Moné, the current AEW TBS Champion, recently sent wrestling fans into a frenzy with a nod to her past during AEW Grand Slam Mexico. This unexpected tribute to her “Sasha Banks” persona has vintage wrestling fans buzzing with excitement.
Mercedes Moné, formerly known as Sasha Banks in WWE, paid homage to her past and wrestling idol Eddie Guerrero.
Mercedes Moné referenced her time in WWE. She honored her wrestling idol, the late Eddie Guerrero. The reference occurred during AEW Grand Slam Mexico. Who is Mercedes Moné paying tribute to? Mercedes Moné, also known as Sasha Banks, delighted fans by referencing her WWE past. She also paid tribute to her wrestling idol, the late Eddie Guerrero, during AEW Grand Slam Mexico.
A Walk Down Memory Lane The former WWE star, a prominent figure in the wrestling world, is currently thriving as the TBS Champion in AEW. Moné has always been open about her wrestling idol, the legendary Eddie Guerrero.
Mercedes’ post on social media [Credit: Mercedes Moné on Instagram] A Nostalgic Moment During AEW Grand Slam in Mexico, Moné took the opportunity to honor her past with a heartfelt tribute. She shared a photo on social media showcasing a pair of socks: one representing her WWE days as “The Boss” and the other featuring a picture of Eddie Guerrero.
Fans are sure to love this nostalgic touch from the AEW TBS Champion, and many hope she continues to honor her wrestling hero.
